topics.angle: Habits and psychology of people who quietly build wealth - frugality, ownership, patience, debt-free living, honest trade; no interest, gambling or get-rich-quick. Hook with a concrete vivid question in the first 10 s -> 5-7 beats, each a mini-story with a visual mechanism -> twist -> short recap. Never dry lists.
